author: Guaka
text: https://github.com/Trustroots/trustroots/issues would be best place for tech issues, at least from dev perspective. From a user perspective it might be better to use something else. Any ideas?

author: Tjipetir
text:
Kasper, any kind of (FOSS) forum or even wiki would do. Something users can search, for questions already asked. It would also be nice if it makes use of a SSO (Single Sign On, for TR as a whole... main site, blog comments, forum posts, etc.)

I'm so pleased to see all the new dots appearing on the map, every time I log in - onward and upward!

author: Kasper Souren
text:
There's https://github.com/Trustroots/trustroots/wiki
